method: Read datePublished and dateModified from each article's JSON-LD (explicit UTC, 'Z'), then compare with the date line shown on the page. Pages fetched directly on 2026-11-05, no archive.

publishers.basis: machine-readable: displayed 1:55 PM equals datePublished 18:55:54Z converted to CDT
machine-readable: displayed 4:33 PM equals datePublished 20:33:00Z converted to EDT

examples.published_vs_cutoff: before the cutoff by about 19 hours
examples.modified_vs_cutoff: before the cutoff; current content dates from 12:50 UTC, so the current version existed before the cutoff

publishers.basis: machine-readable: displayed 11:29 AM equals datePublished 15:29:00Z converted to EDT. The page also carries an unrelated datePublished (14:46:54Z) that is not the article's.

examples.modified_vs_cutoff: edited 45 seconds and 28 minutes after the cutoff; the original version needs an archived capture before the cutoff

publishers.basis: not resolved. The page-level datePublished (2025-11-04T05:45:00Z) and dateModified cover the whole rolling page, not each dated entry. Entry times on the page have no zone and no year.

examples.note: page-level only; entries need their own calibration
